transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?
I guess… I’m here because I lost my temper. Blew up at one of the younger volunteers over a tablecloth being crooked. I don’t usually talk to people like that.
Has this kind of reaction happened before, or do you often feel like your emotions are hard to control in other situations?
Not really… not like that. I mean, I can get annoyed, sure, but blowing up over something as small as a crooked tablecloth—that’s not how I usually am. I don’t usually talk to people that way.
Can you think of any other times when you reacted more strongly than you expected, especially in situations involving other people?
Not really other times, no. The main thing is what I said… I snapped at that young volunteer about the tablecloth being crooked. It was too much, and I don’t usually speak to people like that.
Can you describe how you felt in the moment before you snapped at the volunteer? Were you feeling particularly overwhelmed, frustrated, or upset about something else?
I don’t know… I guess I was wound up. It was just a crooked tablecloth, but I snapped at him like it was a big thing. I don’t usually talk to people that way.
Can you tell me about how you usually get along with others—especially in situations where you're working together or in close proximity, like with volunteers or coworkers?

I usually get along all right with people. I’m not much for fussing with anyone. That’s why this bothered me… I snapped at one of the younger volunteers over a crooked tablecloth. It wasn’t like me to talk that way.
Have you ever had ongoing problems with your temper or difficulty getting along with others, even before this incident with the volunteer?

No… not really. I mean, I’ve had my moments like anybody, but I haven’t had trouble getting along with people. That’s why this shook me some — blowing up at that young volunteer over a crooked tablecloth. I don’t usually talk to people like that.
Can you recall if you’ve ever had sudden outbursts that came out of nowhere, where you felt like you lost control completely, even for a short time?

Not completely, no… not like I was out of control. Just that time with the young volunteer—I raised my voice over a crooked tablecloth. It caught me off guard, because I don’t usually speak to people that way.
Do you often find yourself needing things to be done a certain way, like being very particular about how tasks are completed or how things are arranged?
I don’t think so. I mean… I like things neat enough, but I wouldn’t say I’m usually particular like that.
Do you tend to avoid social situations or feel uncomfortable around others, even if you don’t lose your temper?
Lately, yes… a bit. I stopped going to card nights. I just don’t feel quite steady around people right now. And I haven’t kept up with organizing the Día de los Muertos event like I usually do.
Has this incident with the volunteer affected your ability to do your usual activities or interact with others in your community?
Yes… I suppose it has. I haven’t really kept up with the Día de los Muertos planning like I usually would. And I stopped going to card nights for now. I just don’t feel quite steady around people.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried most days, even when there isn’t a specific reason for it?
Not most days, no. I get uneasy sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s just there all the time for no reason.
Do you find that you’re more irritable or quick to anger these days, even in situations that wouldn’t have bothered you before?
Yes… I suppose so. That’s really what brought me in. I snapped at one of the younger volunteers over a tablecloth being crooked. It wasn’t… it wasn’t like me to talk to someone that way.
Do you find that your irritability or anger lasts for most of the day, even when things are going normally?

No… not most of the day. It’s more that I had that one blowup with the young volunteer, over something stupid like a crooked tablecloth. That’s what worried me. I don’t usually talk to people that way.
Have you noticed feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even when things aren’t stressful?
Not really… I mean, I have my moments, but I wouldn’t say I’m hopeless or that I’ve stopped caring about things.
Have you noticed yourself being more irritable or easily annoyed in general, even when you’re not in situations that involve other people or stress?

Not really in general, no. It’s more… what I mentioned, that I blew up at that young volunteer over the tablecloth. That’s the thing that bothered me, because I don’t usually speak to people like that.
Have you noticed yourself feeling more irritable or angry in general, even when you're not in situations that would usually upset you?
No… not just out of nowhere. It was mostly that incident I already mentioned, with the young volunteer and the crooked tablecloth. I snapped at them, and that’s not really like me.
Have you had difficulty getting close to people or forming close relationships, or do you often feel like you don't fit in with others?
I don’t think so. I’ve never been the most outgoing, but I wouldn’t say I can’t get close to people or that I don’t fit in.
Have you ever acted on sudden impulses that were harmful or out of character for you, even if it wasn’t directed at another person?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t done anything like that… not that comes to mind.
Have you felt down or lost interest in things you usually enjoy for more than a couple of days at a time in the past few weeks?
Not really, no. I mean… I’ve had off days, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been down or lost interest for days on end.
Have you noticed any other instances in the past few weeks where you felt unusually angry or irritable, even if you didn’t act on it or it didn’t seem to come from anywhere?

Yeah… I guess there was that one time. That’s actually part of why I came in. I snapped at one of the younger volunteers over a tablecloth being crooked. It wasn’t like me to talk to someone that way.
